title: Concept: Dependency installed from an anonymous gist
description: package.json declares a gist dependency, which resolves an anonymous paste rather than a package, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: A gist has no publisher identity, no registry attestation and no integrity value, so the code that runs is whatever the paste holds when the install fetches it.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through package.json (npm).
risk: A gist has no publisher identity, no registry attestation and no integrity value, so the code that runs is whatever the paste holds when the install fetches it.
